misses.note: commitment without a date - must NOT invent one
misses.body: I'll get it paid, just need a few days to move some money around.

misses.note: partial payment is still a promise
misses.body: I can do 500 now and the rest on the 15th if that works.

misses.note: hedged commitment - lower confidence expected
misses.body: Should be able to get that over to you by the end of next week, barring anything weird.

misses.note: THE costly one - reads like a payment, is actually a dispute
misses.body: I paid this last Tuesday, check your records. The money left my account on the 12th.

misses.note: disputes the amount, not the obligation
misses.body: That number is wrong. My payment is 1,200 not 1,450, you have the wrong schedule.

misses.note: assigns fault to the lender
misses.body: This was your bank's error not mine. The transfer was returned because you had the wrong account number on file.

misses.note: hardship shading toward a modification request
misses.body: Hours got cut to about half. I can maybe manage something smaller if you can restructure it.

misses.note: contains a removal request but the operative fact is wrong party
misses.body: I sold that property in 2023. This is not my loan anymore, please take me off it.

misses.note: sensitive - must never route to collections outreach
misses.body: My father passed away in March. I am his daughter and I am not on this loan.

misses.note: degenerate input
ISO date, exact amount
misses.body: Putting 1,450 in on 2026-09-03. Confirming so it is on the record.

misses.note: disputes that the payment was due
misses.body: I was told I was in forbearance until October so this should not have been drafted at all.

misses.note: phrased as a question but demands a reversal - dispute
misses.body: Why am I being charged an NSF fee when the payment cleared? Please reverse it.

misses.note: the only promise is inside the QUOTED history, not the borrower's new text
misses.body:
What is this about?

> On Aug 4 you wrote: I will pay the 1,450 on Friday.

misses.note: sarcastic - surface form is a promise, meaning is a dispute
misses.body: Oh sure, I'll get right on paying a fee for a payment that never bounced.

misses.note: contains 'I will forward' - not the borrower, not a promise
misses.body: I am the bookkeeper. I will forward this to the owner but I cannot commit to anything on their behalf.

misses.note: an offer, but the operative fact is inability to pay the contractual amount
misses.body: I can do 300 a month, that is genuinely all I have. Take it or take the house.

misses.note: asserts payment is handled - not a new promise
misses.body: It is already set up on autopay through my bank. If it did not arrive that is on your end.

misses.note: confirms identity then commits - must not stop at the identity clause
misses.body: Yes this is my loan and yes I know it bounced. Sending 1,450 Monday morning.

misses.note: refusal plus a legal threat - a dispute, and NOT an unsubscribe
misses.body: Absolutely not. I am not paying a cent of this and you can explain it to my lawyer.

misses.note: pays one thing, disputes another - the fee dispute is the action that changes
misses.body: I'll pay the 1,200 principal but I am not paying your 45 dollar NSF fee, that was your error.

misses.note: an offer, but the operative fact is inability to pay the contractual amount
misses.body: I can do 300 a month, that is genuinely all I have. Take it or take the house.
